title: Ethiopian Roasted Beef
community: Ethiopian restaurants and celebrations — the spiced whole roast
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Spiced Beef Roast — a joint of beef marinated in berbere, kibbeh, garlic, and ginger, slow-roasted until deeply caramelised and tender. The celebration roast — the Ethiopian version of the Sunday roast, served at Easter and Christmas.
longDesc: Ethiopian beef roast takes the traditional slow-roasting technique and applies the full berbere spice tradition to produce a roast that is simultaneously familiar in format and completely Ethiopian in character.
steps: Mix marinade. Pierce beef all over. Rub marinade in thoroughly.
Bring to room temperature 1 hour before roasting.
Roast at 160°C for 75—90 minutes, basting every 20 minutes.
chefTips: Pierce the beef deeply for the marinade to penetrate.
Low and slow — 160°C for maximum tenderness.
cookingScience: See KEN224 for roasted beef science.
reheating: Slice and warm in oven or kibbeh.
culturalNote: Ethiopian spiced beef roast is the celebration showpiece — brought whole to the table and carved in front of guests, it signals that the host has spared nothing.
